description: Set how many processes of one type an app or agent runs, the size they run on, or both. For an app, give process_type, such as web, and a count from 0 up to the organization's cap. For an agent, count is 0 (paused) or 1 (running). size is economy-1x, which stops after 30 minutes without traffic and starts again on the next request, or standard-1x, the same machine, which never stops; changing size restarts the processes. Give count, size, or both; omitting one keeps it. Scaling down stops running processes, and scaling web to 0 takes an app's URL offline, so confirm with the user first. Setting what it already has changes nothing. Websites run no process and are refused. Changing an agent's model is not offered here. Requires connecting a Valet account.

count.description: How many processes of the type to run. An agent runs 0 (paused) or 1 (running); an app runs as many as the organization's cap allows. Omit to keep the count; give count, size, or both.

kind.description: Omit to scale whatever the name holds; give it to have a name holding another kind refused.

org_name.description: The Valet organization it belongs to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

process_type.description: The Procfile process type to scale, such as web. Give it for an app. An agent has none; omit it.

size.description: The size the processes run on: economy-1x stops after 30 minutes without traffic, standard-1x never stops. Omit to keep the size.

name: scale_service

name.description: Name of the app or agent that was scaled.

org.description: Name of the Valet organization the call acted in.

process_types.description: The scale of each process type after the call. For an app, every type of its formation; for an agent, one entry.

scale.description: How many processes of this type run now. 0 runs nothing.

size.description: Size the processes run on. Absent when none is recorded.

type.description: Process type, such as web. An agent reports agent.

title: Scale an app or agent
